messages:
Maya S: thinking out loud — small proposal: add a compact release-template + a /deploy preflight command so PMs/SEs can generate release notes + change-window in one shot. keeps humans from copy-pasting wrong sections.
Jon P: +1. low friction is key. what fields do you want in the template?
Maya S: minimal: version, change-window, quick TL;DR, risk-level, rollback-reason, migration-steps (if any), and a single line of verification steps. example: 
```
version: 2026-03-20-1234
change_window: 03/22 02:00-03:00 UTC
summary: reduce inference p99 by fixing batching bug
risk: medium
rollback: pin traffic to v2026-03-19 or run rollback-script
migrations: none
verify: smoke test /api/health & perf-check 99th latency
```
Priya K: can deploy-bot auto-fill the current canary pins and suggested rollback commands? that would be neat.
DeployBot: idea accepted — endpoint /deploy/preview can return current pins, recent canary results, and a suggested rollback snippet. (prototype available) :robot_face:
Aaron L: prototype sounds great. devex ask: let's also add a `--dry-run --notes` flag so people can do `deploy --dry-run --notes` to generate the changelog + preflight checklist without touching infra.
Lucy R: also recommend a tiny lint step that enforces 'rollback' present for medium/high risk. i've seen releases with no rollback plan.
Maya S: yep — rule: if risk != low then rollback line required. bot should reject or prompt.
Jon P: UI idea — post the generated template as a thread message with reactions for approve/changes (:white_check_mark:, :pencil:). if no :white_check_mark: after 30m auto-escalate to oncall? maybe too heavy.
Emily G: maybe auto-escalate only for high-risk and outside business hours. otherwise just ping the assignees.
Priya K: include a small preflight checklist the bot can run: run `smoke-test`, `schema-check`, `kv-cache-warmup` and `canary-smoke`. bot prints a summary.
Maya S: sample cli usage for the team: 
```
# generate notes + preflight but don't deploy
deploy-bot preview --notes --dry-run --change-window "03/22 02:00-03:00 UTC" --risk medium

# kick off canary with the generated template attached
deploy-bot start --template /tmp/release-notes.yaml --canary 10% --monitor 15m
```
Aaron L: + mention to include a minimal template tag so logs add `release:2026-03-20-1234`. that'll help filtering.
Maya S: good call. i'll add `release_tag` and have the bot annotate traces and logs.
DeployBot: prototype endpoints and sample script posted: https://internal/redwood/devex/deploy-preview (link).
Priya K: can someone own a tiny RFC for this? lightweight doc + the bot flags + lint rules. i can start it.
Maya S: if Priya can start, i'll help with the templates and the lint function. Jon can you review the bot UX?
Jon P: happy to. will scope the UX flows and reactions.
Lucy R: i'd like to add a small checklist item: `fallback_model_variant` if it's a model rollout. we had an outage where fallback missing caused latency spike.
Maya S: noted. will add fallback field.
Emily G: agree on templates. also let's add a short 'postmortem' checkbox that links to a template if something goes wrong — automatic reminder 24h after rollback.
Maya S: perfect. i'll open a PR with: bot flags, template examples, lint rule, and a short changelog generator script. aiming for draft by EOD tomorrow.
Jon P: thanks — ping #eng-oncall and #release-coord when PR ready.
DeployBot: ticket created: RB-4521 "release-template + deploy preview" assigned to @Priya K and @Maya S. status: triaged.
